title: korea-scholarship-mcp: An MCP server for the Korea Citation Index and Open Access Korea
description: A FastMCP stdio server that exposes KCI (Korea Citation Index, National Research Foundation of Korea) and OAK (Open Access Korea, National Library of Korea) as eight tools for AI clients: article search, full-record and reference lookup, journal citation indices, and keyless OAI-PMH harvesting of both repositories. Four of the eight tools require no credentials. Responses use a typed envelope that reports query script, matching mode, result-set breadth, harvest truncation and source-specific field asymmetries rather than smoothing them. Korean counterpart to cinii-mcp and jstage-mcp. Works with any MCP-compatible client.
